Run two synthetic passing test classes asynchronously and use one resulting AsyncApexJobId; create a second synthetic scratch user. Set ClassesEnqueued=1, ClassesCompleted=1, TestTime=1, StartTime and EndTime, and Status=Completed. At each API version attempt an ApexTestRunResult with the job ID but no UserId, then with a valid UserId but no AsyncApexJobId. Treat rejection as setup evidence only because detailed error messages were unavailable.
